name: Seiko Group Corporation
summary: Seiko Group Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the watch, device solution, system solution, clocks, apparel, fashion accessories, system clocks, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers wristwatches under the Grand Seiko, King Seiko, Prospex, Astron, and Presage brands; wall and alarm clocks; and system clocks and digital signage/sports timing products. It also provides micro batteries and capacitors; quartz crystals and ICs for quartz oscillators; infrared sensor modules; metal and rare earth magnets; precision processed parts; machine tool and automation equipment; thermal printers; and inkjet heads.
